entities.name: André Guelfi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Guelfi was a French racing driver. He was born in Mazagan, Morocco. He participated in one Formula One World Championship race, on 19 October 1958. He also participated in several non-championship Formula One races. At the time of his death, he was the oldest living Formula One driver and had been since the death of Robert La Caze on 1 July 2015.
